explanation: The baseline is the average weekly units in the 4 weeks before the start: (25 + 27 + 23 + 25) / 4 = 25. The promotion averaged (61 + 55 + 59) / 3 = 175 / 3, about 58.33 units a week, so it sold about 33.33 extra units a week. Uplift = 100 x (175 / 3 - 25) / 25 = 133.3%. Dividing the extra units by the promotion average instead of the baseline, 100 x 33.33 / 58.33, gives 57.1% and uses the wrong denominator.
